name: flutter-scaffold

Copy into the repo only: macos/, windows/, .metadata and analysis_options.yaml. Never copy its lib/main.dart, test/widget_test.dart, README.md or .gitignore; there is no lib/main.dart until a later Step.
2. pubspec.yaml: name swiftie_quiz, description "A Taylor Swift trivia game", publish_to none, version 0.3.0+1, environment sdk ^3.13.0 and flutter >=3.47.5. 5. Replace windows/runner/resources/app_icon.ico with src-tauri/icons/icon.ico.
6. Assets: copy design/cat-v2/cat-icon-v2.svg to assets/cat/cat-icon.svg unchanged; copy each src/assets/cats/<name>.svg to assets/cats/<name>.svg and src/assets/sounds/quack.mp3 to assets/sounds/quack.mp3 unchanged; create assets/icons/.gitkeep (empty). Do not move or delete anything under src/.
7. .gitignore: keep every existing line and append Flutter's standard ignores (.dart_tool/, .flutter-plugins-dependencies, /build/, /coverage/, *.iml, .idea/, macos/Flutter/ephemeral/, windows/flutter/ephemeral/, app.*.symbols, app.*.map.json).
